title: Localized Besicovitch–Lebesgue differentiation of a density
statement: Let P ∈ ℕ and let U ⊆ ℝ^P be open. Let μ be a Borel measure on ℝ^P, θ : ℝ^P → [0, ∞] Borel measurable, and ν := μ.withDensity θ (ν(A) = ∫_A θ dμ). Assume μ(K) < ∞ and ν(K) < ∞ for every compact K ⊆ U. Then for μ-a.e. x ∈ ℝ^P with x ∈ U, ν(B̄_ρ(x))/μ(B̄_ρ(x)) → θ(x) in [0, ∞] as ρ ↓ 0. Here B̄_ρ(x) is the closed ball and the quotient is taken in [0, ∞].
lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (μ : Measure (Euclid P)) (θ : Euclid P → ℝ≥0∞), IsOpen U → Measurable θ → (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → μ K ≠ ∞) → (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → μ.withDensity θ K ≠ ∞) → ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, x ∈ U → Tendsto (fun ρ : ℝ => μ.withDensity θ (closedBall x ρ) / μ (closedBall x ρ)) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 (θ x))
